name: ide-panes
description: IDE panes: project explorer and git view

editorKeymap.title: Editor keymap
editorKeymap.description: Key preset of the Explorer's editor

editorKeys.title: Editor key overrides
editorKeys.description: JSON of action to chord, e.g. {"duplicateLines":"ctrl+shift+d","deleteLines":["ctrl+y"]}

previewEngines.title: Preview engines
previewEngines.description: JSON of file extension to an external command previewing it ({path}, {out} substituted; as: text, code, markdown or png), e.g. {"pdf":{"cmd":["pdftotext","{path}","-"],"as":"text"},"psd":{"cmd":["magick","{path}[0]","{out}"],"as":"png"}}
